newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo falls at open on 9-month results.
newsitem.headline: Volvo falls at open on 9-month results.

text.p: Shares in Swedish automotive group AB Volvo fell as the market opened on Wednesday after the company posted nine-month profits that fell short of market expectations.
The share dipped four crowns in initial trade to 137, but then clawed back some of the early losses by 0810 GMT to stand at 188.5 crowns, 2.5 down on Tuesday's close.
Volvo posted a nine-month profit of 12.03 billion crowns which was 12 percent higher than a year ago but lower than expected with analysts on average forecasting a 12.79 billion crown profit.
